messages:
alex: Opening PR: private-install playbook updates. It bundles network preflight checklist (dualstack, MTU, DNS), HSM/KMS connector notes, semi-airgap bundle verification, and a systemd unit example for hsm-agent. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — please review.
maya: SG. Can we extract the network checks into a tiny script so ops can run it during preflight?
jun: I can add conncheck.sh snippet. Quick q: do we recommend nftables by default for sealed sites or keep both examples?
samir: Prefer nftables for modern distros. I'll add a minimal ruleset and call out conntrack_kernels + rp_filter. Also will note iptables-nft compatibility.
samir: ```bash
# minimal nftables for outgoing-only sealed site
nft add table inet rw
nft add chain inet rw forward { type filter hook forward priority 0 \; }
nft add rule inet rw forward ct state established,related accept
nft add rule inet rw forward ct state new oifname "eth0" accept
```
ops-jen: CI preview failing in the PR: checksum step reports mirror.gpg link 404. @docs-bot can you confirm the broken URL?
docs-bot: Link check failed: /offline/mirror/gpg-signing-key - 404. See CI job 212 for details.
alex: I updated the mirror URL in the draft and added a SHA256 verification section with sample commands. Can someone sanity-check the verify snippet?
jun: LGTM. Small nit: change the systemd unit to Type=notify for hsm-agent so supervisors get readiness. Example below.
jun: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=HSM agent for Redwood
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hsm-agent --config /etc/redwood/hsm.yaml
Restart=on-failure
```
maya: If HSM uses PKCS#11, add a pkcs11-proxy socket example and a note about mapping /dev nodes for on-prem installs.
samir: Added a short paragraph about using socat for USB HSM bridging in semi-airgap installs (USB over serial + ephemeral rsync of shaped bundle).
ci-bot: Preview build passed after link fix — https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/212/preview.png :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks. Tagging reviewers @maya @jun @samir. Plan: merge EOD PST unless blockers. Labels: docs/quickstart, backport/1.2.
ops-jen: One more: include a tiny compatibility table calling out iptables-legacy vs iptables-nft and kernel conntrack limits (nf_conntrack_max) — some customers on older kernels hit defaults.
maya: Will add the compatibility table and a short mitigation note (increase nf_conntrack_max in /etc/sysctl.conf).
alex: Great. I'll push the final updates in ~30m and then merge. Follow-ups can happen in PR comments. Closing thread here.
